messages.精神力を大きく払って1コインから大量の破裂を付与する、精神減少を苦にしない人格向: A starting Gluttony Slash E.G.O for Identities unbothered by SP loss, paying a lot of SP to inflict heavy Rupture from a single Coin.
messages.表裏で変わる1コイン: 表面的中時は破裂を付与して精神力が10減る。裏面的中時は: **A single Coin that changes with Heads or Tails**: On Heads Hit, it inflicts Rupture and he loses 10 SP. On Tails Hit, he recovers 10 SP. On Heads, combined with the 10 Sanity cost, he effectively pays 20.
messages.破裂の付与量: 破裂回数を与える他の攻撃と組み合わせると、破裂を一気に積める。: **Rupture amount**: Combined with other attacks that grant Rupture Count, it stacks Rupture quickly.
messages.パッシブ「不安定」: 1つのスキルで直前のコインと別の面が出ると、精神力-5とダ: **Passive — Unstable**: When a Coin lands on a different face from the previous Coin within one skill, he loses 5 SP and gains 1 Damage Up (up to 3 times per turn). This skill has 1 Coin, so it does not trigger it itself; it happens with other multi-Coin skills after use.
messages.耐性と侵蝕: 憤怒・傲慢が脆弱、暴食が抵抗。初期E.G.Oなので侵蝕スキルは無い: **Resistances and Corrosion**: Fatal to Wrath and Pride, Endured against Gluttony. As a starting E.G.O, it has no Corrosion skill.
messages.破裂を積みたい相手に撃つ。破裂付与の別攻撃と合わせると効果が大きい。: Fire it at enemies you want to stack Rupture on. It is more effective combined with other Rupture-inflicting attacks.
messages.撃つと次ターン以降も精神力が下がるので、精神力に余裕のあるときに使う。: Using it lowers his SP on later turns too, so use it when he has SP to spare.
messages.精神減少が利点になる人格なら、長期戦では早めに使って低精神を保つ手もある。: For Identities who benefit from SP loss, using it early in long fights to keep SP low is also an option.
messages.Ⅱ: 「不安定」が解放される。精神力が減る効果が主なので、利点は小さい。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks Unstable. Its main effect is reducing SP, so the benefit is small.
messages.Ⅲ: 基本威力が10から14、破裂が6から12になる。本格的な性能はここから。: **Ⅲ**: Base Power goes from 10 to 14, and Rupture from 6 to 12. This is where it gets serious.
messages.Ⅳ: 表面的中時に次ターンの攻撃威力増加1、裏面的中時に保護1を得る。使う機会が: **Ⅳ**: Grants 1 Attack Power Up next turn on Heads Hit and 1 Protection on Tails Hit. It sees little use, so it is likely a low priority.
messages.握らんとする者: 3つの攻撃スキルが精神力を減らす(7・10・15)ので、精神減: **[The One Who Shall Grip](persona:1005)**: His three attack skills reduce his SP (7, 10, 15), so the SP-loss downside barely affects him, and S3 (Wrath) supplies Wrath.
messages.剣契殺手: S1(暴食)とS2(憤怒)で必要資源の暴食・憤怒を自給できる。: **[Blade Lineage Salsu](persona:1002)**: S1 (Gluttony) and S2 (Wrath) supply the required Gluttony and Wrath himself.
